title: I made a "Druid Revenge" prototype using ChatGPT 5.6 Sol, it's a game where you can take over the city with flowers and leaves
author: trieckaga
selftext: Basically just a couple of prompts to test the idea I've had for a long time

replies.author: trieckaga
replies.body: Unfortunately gamedev isn’t really about the ideas themselves, it’s about implementing them. And that’s where the suffering begins - and where 90% of prototypes end up in the trash. But if you have a strong vision for this idea and tons of time to polish it then yes it might work

replies.author: trieckaga
